title: SRE on-call weekly log — March 09 2026
body:
Weekly summary (2026-03-02 -> 2026-03-09)

Owners/rotations this week:
- Primary on-call (week): Aisha Kapoor (eng-sre)
- Secondary: Devon Lee
- Pager duty: nights covered by L2 followups (Marta)

Top items
1) Incident SRE-2026-031 — us-west-2 embedding generation latency spike (Severity: Sev2)\- Timeline: 2026-03-04 11:12 PST — elevated p95/p99 for embedding endpoint observed in synthetic and customer traffic. Alerts triggered at 11:18; mitigation completed 11:48.\- Impact: ~30% of hosted-api embedding requests experienced 2-3x latency increase (p95 from ~95ms to ~320ms). No permanent data loss; increased tail latency affected a small set of customers using large-batch synchronous embedding calls.\- Immediate mitigation: rolled back autoscaler HPA threshold change deployed 2026-03-04 10:55 (release tag autoscaler-config-2026-03-04). Rolled back to previous replica floor (4 -> pinned to 6 for 2 hours). Warmed KV caches for active pods.\- Root cause hypothesis: new HPA target CPU utilization was lowered too aggressively for the increased sequence-length distributions from recent model variant (v2-embed-large-quant). The HPA reacted by rapidly scaling down under short CPU dips then OOM / cold-cache penalty while traffic spiked.\- Post-incident actions: create JIRA SRE-5234 to track autoscaler safety checks, add a preflight integration test that runs per-merge to platform main to validate HPA floor and scale-up latency, and add telemetry to correlate HPA activity with model-variant rollouts. PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/7892 (autoscaler validation + telemetry).\- Notes: We could have avoided initial pager noise with an early-warning metric on pod spinup latency. Add metric to dashboards.

2) Intermittent SLO burn — generation service p95 (hosted-api text-gen)\- SLO target: p95 <= 150ms (stable traffic mix).\- Observed: rolling 7d p95 = 172ms; 24h p95 = 180ms. Error budget burn rate = 2.3 (high).\- Contributors: increased synchronous burst traffic from two internal feature tests + several customer A/B rollouts to new prompt templates increasing average token length.\- Mitigation in progress: throttle internal test traffic (ticket: OPS-2786), enable intelligent client-side batching recommendations via Redwood Optimize temporarily for top noisy keys, and schedule a model-variant rollback for peak hours to the lower-latency quantized variant.\- Follow-ups: update SLO dashboard with prompt-length heatmap, add alert when p95 crosses 160ms for >30m with a 'soft' severity, and revisit default batching settings in SDK.

3) Maintenance & planned work\- Postgres vacuum job in prod-primary (maintenance window): 2026-03-12 01:00-02:30 UTC. Expected small blips in control-plane writes (console metadata). SRE will monitor migrations and keep a none/low impact severity. Communication: email to customers with reserved capacity this week.\- Kernel security patch (CVE-2026-1452) scheduled for private deployments next week (contact: private-deployments infra lead). Ensure on-call has patch runbook and rollback instructions.

Runbook and playbook updates\- Runbooks updated this week:
  • embedding-service-runbook: added HPA troubleshooting checklist and measured safe floors.
  • oncall-escalation: clarified secondary escalation path to platform-eng pager at 20m and SRE manager at 45m for Sev2+.\- Identified gaps: no automated test that validates autoscaler response for model-variant-induced CPU patterns. Action: add chaos test (JIRA-SRE-5235) that simulates a short burst of long sequence-length requests and verifies scale-up within SLA.

On-call handoffs (important context for next rotation)\- Handover notes for next primary (Marta Ruiz):
  • Watch embedding HPA alerts closely; current temporary pin set by SRE-incident rollback (pinned_replicas=6). Do not unpin without running autoscaler smoke test.
  • SLO burn for text-gen: expect higher p95 between 14:00-18:00 UTC due to scheduled marketing load tests on 2026-03-10 (internal). If p95 breaches 200ms and error budget burn >3, escalate to Devon for immediate traffic shaping.\-  \  • Night ops contact: Priya Nair (DB) for any control-plane write stalls during vacuum.

Meeting notes — runbook review (2026-03-06)\- Attendees: Aisha, Devon, Marta, Priya, Sam (platform-eng)\- Decisions: add a new dashboard panel 'HPA spinup latency' and a pager rule tied to spinup > 12s for embedding pods.\- Open questions: who owns autoscaler canary validation in CI? (tentative: infra-team, Sam owns).

Action items (owner / ETA)
- SRE-5234: Autoscaler safety checks + telemetry (Aisha / 2026-03-16)\- SRE-5235: Autoscaler chaos test (Devon / 2026-03-23)\- OPS-2786: Throttle internal test traffic & notify teams (Marta / 2026-03-11)\- Update SDK default batching recommendations (product + devx / 2026-03-19)

Notes to self / informal:
- Need to reduce noise from low-severity HPA flaps — maybe add a suppression window for flaps that do not correlate with customer 5xxs.\- Consider adding a synthetic that continuously runs the most-common long-prompt across regions to act as canary for embedding regressions.

Customer-facing follow-up
- Drafted email for affected customers summarizing incident, mitigations, and timeline. Will send after post-incident review complete.

Postmortem status
- Initial timeline and mitigation are in this doc. Full postmortem skeleton created in Confluence (linked_artifacts above). Targeting final postmortem & RCA by 2026-03-18.

Appendix: quick metrics (snapshot 2026-03-09 08:00 UTC)\- embedding-service availability (7d): 99.90% (SLO 99.95%)\- text-gen p95 (24h): 180ms (SLO 150ms)\- pagers this week: 4 (1 Sev2, 3 Sev3)

If anything else needed before handoff ping me on Slack (#sre-oncall) or update JIRA-SRE-5234.
